name: Tinfoil
short_desc: External: Private AI. Connect your Tinfoil API key; your agent gets a private model.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Private AI inference for your Wizard. Paste a Tinfoil API key (from dash.tinfoil.sh) and your agent gets a private model choice: every request goes through Tinfoil's official SDK, which checks the secure enclave before anything is sent, with no unverified fallback. The key stays inside this app; the agent only gets a local token for this box. Needs the Hermes Agent app (or a Wizard installed alongside an existing Hermes).

form_fields.label: Hermes Agent dashboard username
form_fields.hint: Filled in automatically from your Hermes Agent app. Used only to add Tinfoil to the agent's models.

form_fields.label: Hermes Agent dashboard password
form_fields.hint: Filled in automatically from your Hermes Agent app. The agent gets only a local token, never your Tinfoil key.

form_fields.label: Hermes Agent dashboard address (optional)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty to use the Hermes Agent app (http://hermes-agent:9119).
